findings.evidence: We collect personally identifiable information about you when you specifically and knowingly provide such information voluntarily on the Site, including, but not limited to, during the following interactions: (1) when you register on the Site and when you later log-on with your user name and password; (2) when you sign-up to subscribe to a service, a newsletter, or ask to be added to our mailing lists for other products or services; (3) when you place an order for products or services; (4) when you participate in a promotional offer; (5) when you provide feedback in an online survey; (6) when you submit other content and suggestions.
findings.rationale: The policy does not explicitly state that it collects demographic information, and instead mentions collecting personally identifiable information broadly.
findings.verifier_reason: The policy evidence describes collecting personally identifiable information broadly, which includes demographic information.
